items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: My cousin died, Gus Greenbott, his bass.

ctx.x: That's a long set, because I was no more than about, oh, 13 or 14 years old. Yeah, well that's after them. That was the Golden Leaf Band. My cousin used to play bass with them. Yeah. My cousin died, Gus Greenbott, his bass. I used to call him Dougie.
